mapper.sql: ar.id, ar.booking_id, ar.approver_id, ar.status, ar.remark, ar.create_time, ar.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.name as approver_name FROM approval_record ar LEFT JOIN user u ON ar.approver_id = u.id WHERE ar.booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC

SELECT , b.title as booking_title, b.start_time, b.end_time, u.name as approver_name FROM approval_record ar LEFT JOIN booking b ON ar.booking_id = b.id LEFT JOIN user u ON ar.approver_id = u.id WHERE ar.status = 0 ORDER BY ar.create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (booking_id, approver_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{approverId}, #{status}, #{remark})
